headline: Less new housing available and prices rising in the Valley of Mexico
summary: New-home inventory in the Valle de México fell 12.9% year on year in the third quarter of 2026, while the average price per square metre rose 9.3%, according to Tinsa México by Accumin.
why: Housing supply and prices drive construction activity, mortgage lending and household wealth, and are watched as indicators of Mexico's domestic economy.
original_headline: Menos vivienda nueva disponible y precios al alza en el Valle de México
